faq: A flex building combines complementary uses, such as an office or showroom and a warehouse or shop, in one building.
Can I have an office and a warehouse in the same steel building?
Yes. We design the building around the office, work, and storage areas you need and the doors and openings each one requires.
Can a flex building be insulated?
Yes. We supply insulation. Tell us how you will use the space and we will include insulation options in your quote.
Can a flex building have more than one tenant?
Buildings can be laid out with multiple bays or suites. Zoning and code requirements for multi-tenant use vary by location, so check with your local building department.
Are flex buildings used as investment properties?
Flex buildings have become a popular model for investors who build to lease to tenants, similar to storage units. Zoning and leasing requirements vary by location.
How long does it take to get a flex building?
Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks. Timelines can vary with project size, options, and demand.
